sourceNotes: This pass started from https://omc.wv.gov/ on 2026-09-08 and stayed on omc.wv.gov. That host is the West Virginia Office of Medical Cannabis. The FAQ at /rules/FAQ/Pages/default.aspx answers that adult/recreational use is not legal, that patients buy at licensed dispensaries, and that growing is unlawful unless the grower/processor has a bureau permit. Act/Rules restates Senate Bill 386 and certified medical use. The older /Pages/FAQ.aspx and /Pages/Patients-Caregivers.aspx paths are 404s; the current FAQ replaced both. The code.wvlegislature.gov citation for adult possession was replaced because that host is not the requested source and this host already answers the question. Fetch with browser headers returns 200 and the excerpts are in the HTML, so these rows do not need a browser.
